_about: Hangouts that play out (hangouts.py). After a hangout, date or crew hangout you picked, one of these comes up: a quick scene with one choice. Each choice is a style (tease, sweet, bold, funny, cheesy, or chill for a safe pick); how it goes depends on what the person likes (chat.py tastes). kind: hang (a friend), date (someone you're into or dating), group (the crew). likes: interests that make it fit (yours or theirs). {them_first} is who you're with, {crew_first} the rest of the crew, {place} where you are. acts: which group activities a scene fits (squad.py): game, park, hoops, food, movie, beach, study.

scenes.title: The dock dare
text: Out at the pond, {them_first} walks to the end of the dock and turns around. "Bet you won't jump in." The water is absolutely freezing.
{them_first} kicks off their shoes at the end of the dock. "Last one in buys food." It is not swimming weather.

choices.label: Cannonball. Right now.
good: You hit the water and come up screaming. {them_first} is laughing so hard they almost fall in too.
meh: You jump. It's cold. {them_first} films it and says it was "a solid six."
bad: You jump and {them_first} just stares. "I was kidding. You're soaked. We have to walk home."

choices.label: "You first, chicken."
good: "Oh it's ON," {them_first} says, and jumps. You both end up in. Worth it.
meh: {them_first} rolls their eyes but jumps anyway. You stay dry and smug.
bad: {them_first} gets weirdly quiet. "Whatever. Never mind." The dare's dead.

choices.label: Film it for the group chat
good: You narrate it like a nature documentary. {them_first} can't stop laughing and makes you send it to everyone.
meh: You get the video. It's fine. Nobody jumps.
bad: "Put the phone down for once," {them_first} says. Oof.

scenes.title: Late night at the diner
text: The diner's almost empty. {them_first} has been drawing on the paper placemat with a crayon from the kids' cup. "Rate it. Be honest."
{them_first} is drawing on the paper placemat with a crayon from the kids' cup. "Rate my art. Be honest."

choices.label: Honest. Brutally honest.
good: You give it a 3 out of 10. {them_first} gasps, then cracks up and signs it "for my harshest critic."
meh: {them_first} shrugs. "Fair."
bad: {them_first} crumples it up. "Okay, wow."

choices.label: Tell them it's actually really good
good: {them_first} pretends not to care, then folds it up and puts it in their pocket.
meh: "You're just saying that," {them_first} says, but they're smiling a little.
bad: "Don't be weird about it," {them_first} says.

choices.label: Just order more fries
good: More fries. Nobody regrets the fries.
meh: More fries. Nobody regrets the fries.

scenes.title: Pickup at the park
text: There's a pickup game going at the park and they're one short. {them_first} looks at you. "We're in, right?"
Two older guys at the court want to play two-on-two. {them_first} is already stretching.

choices.label: "We're taking them out."
good: You talk a big game and then actually back it up. {them_first} won't stop bringing it up for days.
meh: You lose, but it's close. Good sweat.
bad: You talk a big game and get cooked. {them_first} is embarrassed to be seen with you.

choices.label: Trash talk {them_first} the whole time
good: Every miss, you're on them. Every make, they're on you. Best game in weeks.
meh: You get a couple of laughs. Fine game.
bad: {them_first} snaps at you after the third miss. It stops being fun.

choices.label: Pass them the ball every time
good: {them_first} gets hot and you keep feeding them. "You're the best teammate ever."
meh: Nice teamwork. Nobody notices.
bad: "I don't need charity," {them_first} says. Huh.

scenes.title: Digging through records
text: {them_first} holds up the ugliest album cover in the store. "If you can make me like a song off this, I'll buy it."
At the record store, {them_first} hands you one headphone. "Okay. Tell me what you think. And be honest."

choices.label: Do a dramatic review out loud
good: You review it like a movie trailer. The cashier laughs. {them_first} laughs harder.
meh: A couple of laughs. Pretty good song, actually.
bad: {them_first} takes the headphone back. "It's not a joke to me."

choices.label: "I like anything you're into"
good: "That is SO corny," {them_first} says, grinning like an idiot.
meh: {them_first} snorts. "Okay, smooth."
bad: "Ew. Be serious," {them_first} says.

choices.label: Actually listen and say what you think
good: You really listen. {them_first} talks about that song for twenty minutes and you get why they love it.
meh: You say it's good. {them_first} nods.
bad: You overthink it and it gets awkward. "It's just a song," {them_first} says.

scenes.title: Movie night
text: Nobody can pick a movie. {them_first} has been scrolling for fifteen minutes. "Okay, YOU pick. No pressure."
{them_first} wants the horror movie. You can already tell it's going to be a lot.

choices.label: Pick the scariest one
good: {them_first} screams at the first jump scare and grabs your arm. Neither of you mentions it.
meh: It's scary. Fine. You both survive.
bad: {them_first} is not having it and turns it off halfway. "Why would you pick that."

choices.label: Make fun of every scene
good: You do voices for every character. Best bad movie night ever.
meh: A couple of good jokes, a couple of misses.
bad: "Can you let me watch it?" {them_first} asks. Okay.

choices.label: Let them pick, whatever they want
good: Their pick. Good pick, honestly.
meh: Their pick. Good pick, honestly.

scenes.title: The photo booth
text: There's a photo booth by the food court. {them_first} is already pulling you in. "Four pictures. Make them count."
{crew_first} and {them_first} are cramming into the photo booth. There is room for maybe two people.

choices.label: Serious model faces, all four
good: The pictures are unhinged. {them_first} puts the strip in their phone case.
meh: Decent pictures. You look sleepy in one.
bad: {them_first} wanted cute ones. You got weird ones.

choices.label: One normal, one goofy, one sweet
good: The last one is the best picture of you two ever taken. {them_first} makes it their lock screen.
meh: Nice strip. Into the backpack it goes.
bad: It's a little much. {them_first} laughs it off.

choices.label: Photobomb them on purpose
good: Every picture has your face somewhere it shouldn't be. {them_first} is dying.
meh: {them_first} is mildly annoyed, mostly amused.
bad: {them_first} wanted ONE good picture. "Seriously?"

scenes.title: Rock paper scissors for real
text: {them_first} has decided that whoever loses rock paper scissors has to text their crush "hey." Just "hey."
{them_first} has decided: best of three, loser has to sing at the next red light. {them_first} is weirdly confident.

choices.label: Play. And win.
good: You win two straight. {them_first} has to do it. Legendary.
meh: You split it and call it a draw. Cowards, both of you.
bad: You lose. You have to do it. {them_first} has the video.

choices.label: "You're scared, admit it"
good: "I'm NOT," {them_first} says, and then proves it. Chaos.
meh: {them_first} laughs it off.
bad: It hits a nerve. {them_first} changes the subject.

choices.label: Change the bet to loser buys ice cream
good: Ice cream it is. Everybody wins, technically.
meh: Ice cream it is. Everybody wins, technically.

scenes.title: Sunset at the green
text: The two of you end up sitting on the town green as the sun goes down. {them_first} goes quiet for a second. It's nice.
Walking back from getting food, {them_first} bumps your shoulder. "This was fun. Like actually."

choices.label: Hold their hand
good: They don't say anything. They just lace their fingers through yours.
meh: A small smile. They let you, for a minute.
bad: They pull back, gently. "Maybe not yet."

choices.label: Tell them you've been looking forward to this all week
good: "Me too," {them_first} says, and it's obvious they mean it.
meh: "Aw," {them_first} says. Cute.
bad: "Okay, intense," {them_first} laughs, a little stiff.

choices.label: Say something dumb to break the quiet
good: {them_first} laughs and leans into you. You're so in.
meh: A laugh. The moment passes, but it was a good one.
bad: It kills the mood. {them_first} checks their phone.

scenes.title: The ice cream line
text: The line at the ice cream place goes out the door. {them_first} studies the menu like it's a test. "What are you getting? Don't say vanilla."
{them_first} can't decide between two flavors and has been switching for five minutes.

choices.label: "Vanilla. Fight me."
good: {them_first} acts personally offended for the entire walk. Best walk ever.
meh: "Boring," {them_first} says, stealing a bite anyway.
bad: {them_first} just says "okay" and gets quiet. Huh.

choices.label: Get both flavors and split them
good: {them_first} lights up. "Okay, you're the best."
meh: Good plan. Good ice cream.
bad: "I can pick my own ice cream," {them_first} says. Fair.

choices.label: "I'll take whatever's sweetest. Oh wait, you're already here"
good: {them_first} groans so loud people turn around, then laughs for a full minute.
meh: "Wow," {them_first} says. "Wow."
bad: {them_first} physically cringes. The cashier does too.

scenes.title: Who gets shotgun
text: Somehow {crew_first} and {them_first} all end up arguing about who gets shotgun on the way to get food. It's getting heated.
{them_first} and {crew_first} are planning the weekend and nobody can agree on anything.

choices.label: Call it. You're the decider now.
good: You make the call like a coach. Everyone just goes with it. Leader energy.
meh: Half of them grumble, but it works.
bad: "Who made you in charge?" {them_first} says. Now it's worse.

choices.label: Make it a contest
good: Thumb war tournament in the parking lot. {them_first} wins and is unbearable. Perfect.
meh: The contest is dumb. It works anyway.
bad: Nobody's in the mood. The contest flops.

choices.label: Let everyone else pick
good: You stay out of it. Everybody's happy eventually.
meh: You stay out of it. Everybody's happy eventually.

scenes.title: An inside joke is born
text: {crew_first} trips over absolutely nothing, and {them_first} makes a sound you've never heard a person make. Everyone loses it.
Someone mispronounces "quinoa" and now {them_first} and {crew_first} won't stop saying it.

choices.label: Give it a name. It's a whole thing now.
good: It becomes the crew's inside joke for the rest of the year. You started it.
meh: It's funny for an hour.
bad: It doesn't stick. Oh well.

choices.label: Roast {them_first} for the noise
good: {them_first} takes it and dishes it back. Everyone's crying laughing.
meh: A couple of laughs.
bad: {them_first} gets embarrassed. Not great.

choices.label: Make sure nobody actually got hurt
good: Small thing, but {them_first} notices you're the one who checks on people.
meh: Everyone's fine. Back to laughing.
bad: "We're fine, mom," {them_first} says.

scenes.title: The arcade
text: {them_first} has twelve tokens left and wants the giant stuffed shark from the prize counter. It costs four thousand tickets.
There's one air hockey table open. {them_first} cracks their knuckles. "Prepare to lose."

choices.label: Go all in. Spend everything.
good: You both go broke and come out with a keychain and the best night in a while.
meh: You win some tickets. You get a pencil. A great pencil.
bad: You blow your money in ten minutes. {them_first} has to buy the drinks.

choices.label: Talk trash through the whole game
good: Air hockey has never been this loud. {them_first} wants a rematch immediately.
meh: A good game. You lose by one.
bad: {them_first} quits halfway. "You're being annoying."

choices.label: Win them the prize, whatever it takes
good: It takes everything you have, but {them_first} leaves with a tiny shark. They name it after you.
meh: You get a small one. It counts.
bad: You try too hard and it gets awkward. "It's fine, really."

scenes.title: A real conversation
text: Out of nowhere, {them_first} says, "Can I tell you something? Don't make it a thing." They look nervous.
{them_first} has been quiet all afternoon. Finally: "Things are kind of weird at home right now."

choices.label: Just listen
good: You don't say much. You don't need to. {them_first} says thanks like they really mean it.
meh: You listen. They feel a little better.
bad: You say the wrong thing. {them_first} shuts down. "Forget it."

choices.label: Make them laugh to lighten it
good: They laugh for the first time all day. "I needed that."
meh: A small laugh. Better than nothing.
bad: "This isn't funny," {them_first} says. You feel terrible.

choices.label: Tell them something real about you too
good: You both open up. You're closer than you were an hour ago.
meh: It's a little awkward, but it's honest.
bad: Somehow it turns into being about you. {them_first} notices.

scenes.title: Caught in the rain
text: It starts pouring out of nowhere. You're both two blocks from anywhere. {them_first} looks at you like, now what?
The sky opens up the second you leave the store. {them_first} pulls their hood up and laughs.

choices.label: Run for it, race them
good: You race the whole way, soaked, laughing. {them_first} beats you and won't let you forget it.
meh: You get soaked. It's kind of fun.
bad: {them_first} slips and is NOT happy about it.

choices.label: Give them your hoodie
good: {them_first} doesn't give it back. You never see that hoodie again, and you don't mind.
meh: "Thanks," {them_first} says, zipping it up.
bad: "I'm fine," {them_first} says, a little embarrassed.

choices.label: Dance in it like a movie
good: {them_first} tries to look embarrassed and fails. They dance too.
meh: You dance alone. {them_first} films it. Fair.
bad: People are watching. {them_first} wants to disappear.

scenes.title: Weight room bet
text: {them_first} bets you can't hold a plank longer than them. Loser carries the gym bags for a week.
Free shots at the park. {them_first}: "First to ten. Loser does the dishes at my house."

choices.label: Accept. Obviously.
good: You win by a hair. {them_first} demands a rematch tomorrow.
meh: You lose by a hair. Respectable.
bad: You lose badly. {them_first} brags to everyone.

choices.label: Distract them with jokes mid-plank
good: {them_first} collapses laughing. You win on a technicality.
meh: It half works.
bad: "That's cheating," {them_first} says, actually annoyed.

choices.label: Turn it into a workout together
good: You both get better. That's the whole point.
meh: You both get better. That's the whole point.

scenes.title: Around the fire
text: Somebody's backyard fire pit. {crew_first} is roasting marshmallows badly. {them_first} sits down next to you.
The fire's going and someone suggests scary stories. {them_first} is already scooting closer.

choices.label: Tell the scariest story you know
good: Everyone's quiet by the end. Then {them_first} screams at a stick snapping and the whole crew loses it.
meh: Decent story. One person jumped.
bad: You mess up the ending. Brutal.

choices.label: Make {them_first} a perfect marshmallow
good: Golden brown. {them_first} says it's the best one they've ever had and looks at you a second too long.
meh: It's a good marshmallow.
bad: You burn it. They eat it anyway to be nice.

choices.label: Roast the marshmallow AND {crew_first}
good: The fire, the jokes, the crew. Perfect night.
meh: Some laughs.
bad: It goes a little too far. Awkward silence.

scenes.title: Hot mic
text: {them_first}'s mic is on, and somebody in their house is yelling about the dishes. The whole lobby can hear it.
{them_first} forgot to mute and is singing. Badly. Nobody has said anything yet.

choices.label: Turn it into a remix
good: You beatbox under it. Now it's a song. {group} will be quoting it for a month.
meh: A couple of laughs, then back to the game.
bad: Nobody's in the mood. The bit dies.

choices.label: Roast them. Mercilessly.
good: You go all in. {them_first} fires back and the lobby loses it.
meh: {them_first} mutes, unmutes, says "anyway". Fair.
bad: {them_first} leaves the party for ten minutes. Too far.

choices.label: Say nothing, keep playing
good: You let it ride. Somehow you win the round anyway.
meh: You let it ride. Somehow you win the round anyway.

scenes.title: Last one alive
text: Final round. It's you against three, and {group} have gone dead silent in the chat.
Everyone's down but you. {them_first} is whispering "you got this" like it's the World Series.

choices.label: Go in loud
good: You take all three. The chat explodes. {them_first} is screaming your name.
meh: You get two. So close. Respect from everyone.
bad: You go in loud and get dropped instantly. {other_first} sighs into the mic.

choices.label: Narrate your own funeral
good: You do a full sports-announcer play-by-play of yourself losing. Nobody can breathe.
meh: A few laughs while you lose.
bad: "Can you focus," {them_first} says. You cannot.

choices.label: Play it slow and smart
good: Patient. Careful. You win it by a hair.
meh: Patient. Careful. You win it by a hair.

scenes.title: The rage quit
text: {them_first} just lost to a twelve-year-old and is threatening to throw the controller.
{them_first} has been tilted for an hour and just said "this game is rigged" for the ninth time.

choices.label: "You're the best player here, reset"
good: {them_first} takes a breath and wins the next three. "Okay. Okay. Thank you."
meh: It helps a little.
bad: "Don't baby me," {them_first} says. Now it's worse.

choices.label: Screenshot it for the group chat
good: It becomes the group chat's background. {them_first} is furious and also laughing.
meh: {them_first} calls you a word that isn't allowed in school. Fair.
bad: {them_first} logs off. You might've pushed it.

choices.label: Challenge them to a 1v1. Right now.
good: The 1v1 goes nine rounds. {them_first} wins the last one and forgets they were ever mad.
meh: You split it. Everybody's calm now.
bad: You beat them easily. Somehow that made it worse.

scenes.title: The little brother
text: {them_first}'s little brother grabbed the controller mid-match and is somehow winning.
Somebody's little sibling took over {them_first}'s account and is talking way too much trash for a nine-year-old.

choices.label: Recruit the kid
good: The kid joins the squad for one round and gets MVP. {group} have a new hero.
meh: The kid plays one round and gets bored. Classic.
bad: The kid gets you all eliminated. {them_first} is mortified.

choices.label: Let the kid play the whole round
good: You hype the kid up the entire time. {them_first} says their brother won't stop talking about you.
meh: Nice of you. The round's a loss.
bad: The whole lobby gets impatient.

choices.label: Trash talk the kid back
good: You and a nine-year-old trade insults for five minutes. Best entertainment all week.
meh: The kid wins the argument. Fair.
bad: The kid cries. {them_first}'s mom gets on the mic. Nightmare.

scenes.title: One more game
text: It's way past midnight. Somebody says "one more" for the fifth time.
{them_first}: "Last one. For real this time." Nobody believes it, including {them_first}.

choices.label: One more. Always one more.
good: The "last" game is the best one of the night. Worth every lost minute of sleep.
meh: Two more, actually. You're going to be tired.
bad: You lose it, and now you're tired AND mad.

choices.label: Call it, you've got a test
good: You log off like an adult. Nobody judges. Much.
meh: You log off like an adult. Nobody judges. Much.

choices.label: Loser has to change their profile pic
good: {other_first} loses. Their profile pic is now a potato. It stays for a week.
meh: Nobody loses. Somehow a tie.
bad: You lose. You are the potato now.

scenes.title: The new game
text: {other_first} wants everyone to try a new game. It's a farming simulator. They're very excited about it.
{other_first} bought a game nobody's heard of and is begging everyone to download it. It's 40 gigs.

choices.label: Commit to the bit. Best farmer in the server.
good: You roleplay as a very serious farmer for two hours. {group} have never laughed harder at a crop.
meh: It's actually kind of fun?
bad: The bit wears thin by minute ten.

choices.label: Clown on their taste in games
good: You clown it, play it anyway, and end up hooked. {other_first} never lets you forget it.
meh: {other_first} rolls their eyes. You still play.
bad: {other_first} really wanted this one to land. Oops.

choices.label: Actually give it a real try
good: You try it for real. {other_first} is so happy someone gets it.
meh: It's fine. You go back to the usual game after an hour.
bad: You try to like it. You do not like it.
